idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Highlighting a receive with hundreds of clauses that bind the same variable no longer freezes (#1727)
  • Reference searches in other languages, such as PHP code vision, no longer make the Erlang plugin compute their search scope (#1768)
  • The io:format check now warns on modifiers that erlc rejects for the control, such as ~tx or ~ln (#1769)
  • Code completion no longer crashes in files with thousands of nested parentheses (#1767)
  • Reformat Code spaces - and / again when "Uniform binary expressions style" is on (#1765)
  • Reformat Code no longer glues A - -B or X < -1 into other operators when operator spaces are turned off (#1762)
  • Resolving a function in an -import without a module no longer crashes the editor (#1761)
  • and 32 more changes: full list
